description: Canonical structural limits for parsing/validating operator-supplied profile, metadata, and assetSchema JSON. The server and the offline signer MUST enforce EXACTLY these values. Both binaries hardcode them and assert equality against this file in a test. Changing a value here is a frozen-contract change.
maxStringLengthUnit: UTF-8 bytes (Go len(string)/the length of the value's UTF-8 encoding, NOT Unicode scalar values/runes and NOT UTF-16 code units). Applies identically to string values AND object property keys -- every JSON string token in the document. FROZEN: see docs/spec/asset-profile.md 'Max string length unit'.
